goal: Snap windows to the side on Mac

steps.title: Add the Homebrew Cask tap
steps.explanation: This adds a software source to Homebrew. The page says you only need to do it once, and it may no longer be needed on newer Homebrew.

steps.title: Install Rectangle
steps.explanation: This downloads and installs the free Rectangle app, which lets you snap windows to the sides of the screen.

steps.title: Allow Rectangle in Accessibility settings
steps.explanation: Open Rectangle from your Applications folder. Then allow it under Accessibility in System Settings, so it can move windows. The page uses older menu names.

steps.title: Snap a window to the left half
steps.explanation: Press Control, Option and Left Arrow together to snap the active window to the left half of the screen.
